summary: Remove a direct child and return the same node while preserving NotFoundError behavior.

semantics.identity: node object survives detachment with listeners/state intact
semantics.error: NotFoundError DOMException if child is not a child of parent

caveats: Deleting a backend object is wrong; detached nodes remain live JS objects and retain registered listeners.
references: WHATWG DOM Living Standard § Node.removeChild / pre-remove
